g.text: In the 160-task run llama.cpp and ik_llama.cpp grew because llama-server keeps a prompt cache in memory by default (limit 8 GiB); --cache-ram 0 turns it off and was not

g.text: measured. The -rtr rows use the same binary and file as ik_llama.cpp.
